channel.title: Violations Watch: Somalia
channel.description: New incidents reported in Somalia. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: More than 10 civilians reported killed in Deynile district, Mogadishu, in fighting involving troops loyal to the president
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Deynile district, Mogadishu, Somalia. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Troops loyal to the president. Reported casualties: 10 killed. Disputed or caveats: Reported during forced evictions; mainly social-media sources. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0179
